args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion, from Sofia Marchetti (Coastal):

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on Feb 16. Mid-Atlantic home goods retailer; Bettina Kroll is covering the account.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" (per Moss's coverage digest, 18 May). It needs relabelling to Pellow Home Living, since the old label is making supervisor searches run twice.
- "PHL" is also the code for Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast). Check the org ID before any bulk seat audit or PHL-coded action.

Sofia
